_changelog.change: r33.docx reviewer feedback (4 substantive issues). Applied: (Issue 1) Cloud-9 sigma/m >= 50 reframed as 'framework's working assumption' not 'observational lower bound'; sourced to Benitez-Llambay+ 2024 ApJ 973, 61 + Zhou+ 2023 FAST, with §10.4d systematic caveat applied. (Issue 2) 3.6x vs 7.26x inconsistency resolved: 7x compares sigma_eff(v=28)=6.89 to working assumption 50; 3.6x compared 50 to Mace+ 'core-collapse ~ 14 cm^2/g' (different kinematics). Both numbers now disambiguated. (Issue 3) sigma_peak 'novel prediction' reframed to 'best-fit Gaussian Breit-Wigner from framework's parameterization, NOT first-principles'. (Issue 4) §3.5a position vs Das+ rewritten as MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE not complementary — if our v_trans ~ 30-50 km/s framework is correct AND LZ230616 is real, the shared-mediator hypothesis fails; Das+ UV completion and our phenomenological constraint map are exclusive interpretations.

Unified DM model exploration: computed sigma_eff for Mace+ 2026 SIDM2v at v=28 km/s (Cloud-9) using their published parameters (sigma_H/m_H=6.89, w_H=275 km/s, sigma_x/m_H=1.125, w_x=2200 km/s, m_H/m_L=3). Max sigma_eff = 6.89 cm^2/g (f_H=1), factor of 7x short of Cloud-9's sigma/m >= 50 floor. Added §3 'Position vs unified SIDM models' paragraph + v_trans computation (~30-50 km/s for our parameterization, implying m_phi ~ 150-250 eV for m_chi ~ 1 GeV). Added citations [50c] Mace+ 2026 (arXiv:2506.14898) and [50d] Kaplinghat, Tulin, Yu 2016 PRL (arXiv:1508.03339) — original unified SIDM paper. Conclusion: Cloud-9 sigma/m >= 50 is phenomenologically required by floor crossing but structurally difficult for any unified SIDM; sigma_peak window is a genuine novel prediction.

Insight Part 2 exploration: added Das+ 2026 (arXiv:2609.06825) citation as reference [50b]. Added §3.5a 'Position vs concurrent work' paragraph explicitly distinguishing our phenomenological constraint map (multi-resonance + multi-component + gravothermal) from Das+ UV completion (A4 modular + Dirac inverse seesaw + scalar mediator). Stated: Das+ provides the UV; we provide phenomenological constraints on sigma/v and sigma_eff/v. Joint SIDM+LZ fit deferred to v19.2-D future work pending m_phi specification.

User-exact phrasing for 0.085 dex sensitivity framing: 'a value adopted as a sensitivity choice in the v19.2-B pipeline; no literature source reports this exact value.' 6.18σ/7.51σ framed as 'sensitivity result, not a literature-based prediction.'
